title: Assessment of arterial flow characteristics in thrombotic and haemostatic plug formation using CT and DSA
summary: Studienziel ist eine erfolgreiche hämostatische Verschlussbildung (d.h. Zeichen einer Blutung im CT ohne aktive Blutung zum Zeitpunkt der darauffolgenden DSA) mit einem thrombotischen Gefäßverschluss hinsichtlich arterieller Flusseigenschaften zu vergleichen. Die Analyse erfolgt durch Extraktion von Daten aus bildgebenden Untersuchungen und klinischen Datenbanken.
conditions: Presence of a thrombotic occlusion or arterial bleeding
Other and unspecified atherosclerosis of arteries of the extremities

interventions.name: To compare successful hemostatic closure formation (i.e., indications of bleeding in CT without active bleeding at the time of subsequent DSA) with a thrombotic vascular occlusion in terms of arterial flow characteristics.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
CT imaging with contrast agent and at least one arterial phase
• Presence of thrombotic occlusion or arterial hemorrhage (evidenced by CT imaging)
• DSA was performed following CT imaging
• In case of arterial bleeding detected on CT, evidence of spontaneous hemostasis on DSA (i.e. no more bleeding on DSA)
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with evidence of active arterial bleeding on DSA
• Incomplete imaging or insufficient imaging that impairs correct image interpretation (e.g. due to artifacts)
